coherence_critic.label_rule: ssim constrains the magnitude of change only, never its direction; each label is a judgement of the current artifact's coherence, with the ssim used only to confirm a change was in fact claimed.
coherence_critic.baseline_not_reproducible: every file in evidence/.previous/ is byte-identical to its current counterpart (md5 matches on all ten). ssim against an identical image is 1.0, so none of the ssim values recorded in this file can be reproduced from the baseline that shipped with the evidence. the numbers are taken on trust.
coherence_critic.reading_field_check: the 'reading' words are internally consistent with the ssim at a ~0.60 threshold (0.5677 and 0.5901 -> redrawn; 0.6027 and above -> reworked). the vocabulary is coarse: 'reworked' spans 0.6027 to 0.8926, so it says almost nothing.
